versions.subject: CobaltStrike pattern
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|startswith: 'C:\Windows\System32\'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '\sysnative\runonce.exe'
        - '\sysnative\svchost.exe -k netsvc'
        - '\sysnative\svchost.exe -k wksvc'
        - '\sysnative\dmclient.exe'
        - '\sysnative\locator.exe'
        - '\sysnative\systray.exe' 
        - '\sysnative\WUAUCLT.exe'
        - '\sysnative\w32tm.exe'
        - '\sysnative\dllhost.exe -o enable'
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image="C:\\Windows\\System32\\*" CommandLine IN ("*\\sysnative\\runonce.exe*", "*\\sysnative\\svchost.exe -k netsvc*", "*\\sysnative\\svchost.exe -k wksvc*", "*\\sysnative\\dmclient.exe*", "*\\sysnative\\locator.exe*", "*\\sysnative\\systray.exe*", "*\\sysnative\\WUAUCLT.exe*", "*\\sysnative\\w32tm.exe*", "*\\sysnative\\dllhost.exe -o enable*")
